title: Special Executive Programme In Management Information System
description: Unlock the power of data-driven decision-making with a Management Information System course designed to elevate business efficiency and innovation.
longDescription: The Management Information Systems (MIS) course provides a foundational understanding of how organizations use information systems to collect, manage, and analyze data for effective decision-making. The course will begin with an overview of the role of information systems in organizations and the different types of information systems commonly used in businesses today. The course equips students with the skills needed to apply MIS concepts to real-world business challenges, enhancing organizational performance.
courseDetails: Information System, its evolution, types and components. Database and Database Management System. Key Concepts and Types of Database Management Systems and Database Languages. Computer Networking and Its Key Components and types. What is Network Architecture? Information Systems Software. Information Systems V/s Information Technology. ERP, process mapping, Implementation Management and its components. Cloud Computing in Management Information Systems. Artificial Intelligence and Information Systems. Organization and Information Systems and How Information Systems Impact Organizations and Business Firms? Competency, Competitive Advantage, its dimensions. Strategic Information System. Types of Information System Strategies. Management Information System and Competitive Advantage. The Internet’s Impact on Competitive Advantage. Porter’s Five Forces and Competitive Advantage. The Value Chain Analysis and Competitive Advantage. Information Systems Products and Services. Types of Information Systems to Support Business Processes. Alignment Between IS Strategy and Business Strategy. The People in Information Systems. Understand the nature and process of Information Systems Development, its lifecycle, and Implementation Methodologies. Learn about Software Development Processes, models and technologies. Understand the nature, generations and types of Programming Language. Appreciate the concept of Globalization and the role of IT in Globalization. Learn about Information Systems Ethics and the Code of Ethics. Appreciate Acceptable Use Policies and Intellectual Property in IT. The concept of Privacy in Information Systems, its challenges and future trends. Understand Decision-Making dynamics and process Types of decision-making, especially at the managerial level. Understanding and applying the decision-making models, including the decision support system (DSS) and its components. Analysing the Information Requirements of Key Decision-making Groups in a Firm. Identifying and preparing for trends in Decision Support and Business Intelligence. Understanding System Modelling and its Types. Learn about how Management Information Systems help in decision-making. The course provides a detailed understanding of the evolution, key concepts, and applications of MIS in organizational decision-making. It covers the role of MIS in business environments, the relationship between information systems and technology, and strategies for leveraging MIS to gain competitive advantage. Students will also explore topics like database management, cloud computing, and the ethical considerations surrounding information systems in a globalized world. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Introduction To Management Information Systems: Identifying Information Systems & Information Technology: Appraising Information Systems and Organization Strategy: Recognizing Information Systems Development and Globalization: Understanding the Role of MIS in Decision-Making, System Design and Modeling:
